title: Chat with Google Gemini
description: A basic example of a chatbot with chatlas, shiny and Google Gemini.
next_steps: Put your Google AI Studio API key in the `.env` file as GOOGLE_API_KEY.
Run the app with `shiny run app.py`.

follow_up.text: Need help obtaining an API key?
Get one at https://aistudio.google.com/api-keys and see https://posit-dev.github.io/chatlas/reference/ChatGoogle.html
